name: hl-devkit
description: Internal development kit: guardrails, skills and agents for the team workflow

dev_name.title: Developer name
dev_name.description: Your name as it appears in daily reports. Example: Juan

repo_path.title: Work repository path
repo_path.description: Absolute path of the repository you work on. Example: D:\HomeLand\Repo_Huawei

specs_path.title: Specs path
specs_path.description: Absolute path where migration specs are kept, outside any client repository. Example: D:\HomeLand\specs

legacy_path.title: Legacy code path
legacy_path.description: Absolute path of the legacy PHP code on this machine (read-only for the agent). Example: D:\HomeLand\PHP Migration

extra_sensitive_files.title: Extra sensitive files
extra_sensitive_files.description: Additional file name patterns the agent must never read (wildcards * and ?). Example: huawei-credentials.csv, *.secret.json
